title: Nursing from the mazal: three levels from which the mind receives
overview: Where do *chachma* and *bina* of *Atzilus* receive from *Arich Anpin*? The text has three answers, and the chapter shows they are three different kinds of mind. Highest, *Abba* nurses from the *mazal*: a hair that grows out of the leftovers of the hidden brain but is rooted in the skull above it, a narrow pipe from an infinite aquifer. What spills over shows the power behind it, like the mess after a great *farbrengen*; so the Torah is called the *novlos* of the wisdom above. This is where a truly new idea comes from, from higher than *Arich*: the level of *hisbonenus*, and of the wisdom of the days of *Moshiach*. Second, *Abba* and *Ima* enclothe the arms of *Arich*, the *middos* of the will, the dark mountains. A mind driven by love or hate from there thinks bigger, and is bribed: the will overpowers it. Third, the normal mind receives through *netzach* and *hod*, the scales that weigh how much to let through; and *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin* is the smallest of all.

terms.gloss: a hair of Arich's beard and a narrow pipe (tzinor): the channel through which chachma and bina nurse from the koach hamaskil
the power of insight: the hidden aquifer from which every intellect comes out of nothing
the hidden wisdom of Arich, which is the koach hamaskil
the hidden brain of Arich, from whose leftovers the hairs break out
the skull of Arich, in which the hairs are rooted, above the hidden brain
leftovers: what hair is, junk you can cut without feeling it
what falls off an overflowing mind, like leaves off a tree; its root is higher than the mind itself
the thirteen adornments of the beard, the thirteen attributes of mercy
the mountains of darkness: the middos of the will, chesed and gevura of Arich, so high the sun does not shine on them
the mountains of light: the middos that come from the intellect, which the intellect lights up
the world of chaos: the middos of the will taking over, with no intellect to light them up
scales of justice: netzach and hod, which weigh how much to give

sections.title: Three answers to where Abba and Ima receive from Arich
sections.summary: The text gives three places from which *chachma* and *bina* of *Atzilus* receive from *Arich Anpin*: from its *Nehi*, from its arms, and from its *mazalos*. The chapter sets out to show how far apart they are.

phrases.he: (כה) והנה מעתה יש להבין בפרטי ענין עשר ספירות דאצילות דהיינו בירידת האור מחיצוניות נה''י דאריך אנפין באבא ואמא
ולפעמים אומר דאבא ואמא מלבישים לזרועות דאריך אנפין
(ומה שכתוב רישא דמלכא בחסד וגבורה אתתקן
phrases.en: This thing, what it says, that the *reisha d'malka* is enclothed in *chesed* and *gevura*

phrases.he: היינו בחינת רישא דאריך אנפין דאתתקן בחסד וגבורה דעתיק יומין חסד דעתיק יומין בגולגלתא כו' כנזכר לעיל)
ולפעמים אומר דאבא יונק ממזל הח' ונוצר, ואימא ממזל הי''ג ונקה כו':

blocks.text: The chapter turns to where *Abba* and *Ima* (*chachma* and *bina*) receive from *Arich Anpin* (the long countenance). The text gives three answers: from the outside of *Nehi* (*netzach*, *hod*, *yesod*) of *Arich*; from its arms, *chesed* and *gevura*, which is higher; or, *Abba* from the eighth *mazal* (lit. a flow, a channel) and *Ima* from the thirteenth: from *Chabad* (*chachma*, *bina*, *daas*) of *Arich*. (The head of the King fixed in *chesed* and *gevura* is the head of *Arich*, from the last chapter.) So what's the story?

sections.title: Chachma is seeing, and it comes from the hidden koach hamaskil
sections.summary: *Chachma* is *ayin* and *bina* is *yesh*; what people call understanding, seeing the thing, is *chachma*. Its flash is already the *yesh* of *chachma*, drawn from the *koach hamaskil*, the hidden wisdom of *Arich*, the aquifer of all intellect.

phrases.he: אך הנה ידוע בענין כח מה, דהחכמה מאין תמצא, בבחינת אין ובבינה נקרא יש והאור ושפע דאין דחכמה מאיר ונמשך בבחינת השגה דבינה שזהו מאין ליש
ונקרא תרין רעין דלא מתפרשין כו',
phrases.en: that they always work together

phrases.he: כחדא שריין כו'
phrases.en: they are there like one

blocks.text: *Chachma* comes from *ayin* (nothing) and *bina* is called *yesh* (something); the light of the *ayin* of *chachma* is drawn into the grasp of *bina*, from *ayin* to *yesh*. This is a very short recap of chapters 1 and 2. So the two are friends who never part: **they always work together**.

phrases.he: והוא בחינת נקודה דחכמה שמבריק כברק מלמעלה מן השכל
(בלשון העולם, הבנה כו')
phrases.en: What is usually called understanding, that's wisdom, that's *chachma*.

blocks.text: The point of *chachma* flashes like lightning, above the intellect. What the world calls understanding is really *chachma*: someone says, "Oh, I see what you're trying to get at." *Bina* is not that: it analyzes and grasps the thing as a *yesh*. To understand is to finally have it and need no explanation anymore; it is higher than an explanation.

phrases.he: והיינו מכח המשכיל שנקרא חכמה סתימאה דאריך אנפין, ונקרא חכמה נעלמה,
שהוא מקור מוצא כל שכל מאין כו',
phrases.en: That's the actual *makor* where each *sechel* comes from the *ayin*.

phrases.he: ונקרא משכיל כידוע
phrases.en: It's called the actual *maskil*, what gives the *haskalos*.

blocks.text: The flash, the *havraka* (lightning flash), is already the *yesh* of *chachma*: it is *Yesod Abba* (the foundation of *chachma*). It is there but not grasped, and if *bina* does not grasp it right then, it disappears like lightning. It comes from the *koach hamaskil* (the power of insight), which is called the *chachma stima'a* (hidden wisdom) of *Arich*, all covered in chapters 1 and 2.
Hidden like the aquifer, it is **the actual *makor* where each *sechel* comes from the *ayin***: the *maskil* that gives the *haskalos* (insights).

sections.title: The mazal: a narrow channel and a growing hair
sections.summary: *Abba* nurses from the *mazal* as through a narrow pipe from a vast aquifer, and the *mazal* is a hair, a growing thing with a root, that grows new ideas. The two *mazalos* are the roots of *chachma* and *bina* in the *koach hamaskil* itself.

phrases.he: והיינו שאמר דאור אבא יונק ממזל הח', ונוצר
אותיות צנו״ר, כצינור דק
phrases.en: It's like a narrow tube

blocks.title: The aquifer and the narrow vein
blocks.text: *Abba* nurses from the eighth *mazal*, *v'notzer* (and keeps), whose letters spell *tzinor*, a narrow pipe. It is the same *mashal* as the porous earth: the revealed *chachma* is the *maayan* (spring), connected by a narrow vein to the aquifer, and a little tiny bit comes through it from the vast reserves in the *maskil*.

phrases.he: כך בחינת שערות דמזל הח' הוא בחינת צומח שבמשכיל הנזכר לעיל
להצמיח מאין כל מיני השכלות
והיניקה הוא בחינת הגדלת מוחין דאבא והגדלת מוחין דאימא, היינו ממזל הי''ג, ונקה

blocks.text: The tufts of the *mazal* are called hairs because a hair is the growing thing in the *maskil*: it grows all kinds of insights out of nothing, the way a tree grows pears and peaches.

blocks.title: The root and its little well
blocks.text: A hair is like a plant: it *mamash* (actually) has a root, and the root has to get its nourishment from a little well down there. This nourishing is the growth of the *mochin* (minds) of *Abba*: it draws from the end of the thing and grows a new idea.

*Ima* too, nursing from the thirteenth *mazal*, *v'nakeh* (and cleanses), has a root in the *koach hamaskil*. It is called the *koach hamaskil*, but really there are two powers, the *koach hamaskil* and the *koach hamevin* (the power of understanding): basically, *chachma* and *bina* of *Arich*.

phrases.he: וב' מזלות הללו, מזל העליון ומזל התחתון, הן שרשי המוחין דאבא ואמא
והוא בכח המשכיל עצמו, יש שרש הגדלת מוח ההבנה ושרש הגדלת מוח התפיסה וההשגה שהן נקראים מוח אבא ומוח אימא כידוע
וכמו שבחינת מוח בינה שהוא מוח התפיסא וההשגה, מקבל מבחינת האין דמוח החכמה,
כך בשרשם ביחוד ב' מזלות דאריך אנפין ונוצר ונקה כו'
phrases.en: It's also like that: *bina* of *Arich* receives from *chachma* of *Arich*. In the *shoresh*, it's also like that.

blocks.text: The two *mazalos*, the upper and the lower, are the roots of the minds of *Abba* and *Ima*. In the *koach hamaskil* itself is the root of the mind of understanding, which he says means *chachma*, and of the mind of grasp, which is *bina*. As *bina* receives from the *ayin* of *chachma*, so in their root *bina* of *Arich* receives from *chachma* of *Arich*.

sections.title: Leftovers whose root is higher: the hair and the novlos
sections.summary: Hair comes out of the brain's leftovers, yet is rooted in the skull above it, and the pressure that forces it out shows the strength behind it. So too the *novlos* that fall from an overflowing mind: the Torah is called the *novlos* of the wisdom above, and this level, the source of truly new ideas, reaches past *Arich* into *Atik*.

phrases.he: וידוע דגם שהמזלות נקרא שערות, שנבקעים ויוצאים רק מבחינת מותרי מוחא סתימאה דאריך אנפין, אבל שרשן מעצמות הגלגלתא
שלמעלה מגוף פנימיות המוחא סתימאה

blocks.title: Hair rooted in the skull
blocks.text: The *mazalos* are called hairs, which break out only from the leftovers of the *mocha stima'a* (the hidden brain) of *Arich*, but their root is in the essence of the *gulgalta* (the skull). A hair grows from a little well of oily nutrient, and the nutrient comes from the brain, not from the bone; yet the hair is rooted in the skull.
So the *mazalos* that *chachma* and *bina* receive from draw on the *mocha stima'a* of *Arich*, but their root is higher than the body of the *mocha stima'a*, the actual body of the *maskil*.

phrases.he: שלכך נבקעו ויצאו בבחינת מותרות
phrases.en: That's why they broke through and they come out in a way of *mosros*, like that's why they're called hair.

phrases.he: כמשל בקיעת הנוד סתום ביותר כו'

blocks.text: That is why they break through and come out **in a way of *mosros***, leftovers, and why they are called hair. A hair is not even part of the body anymore: you can cut it and feel nothing. It's like junk.

blocks.title: The finger on the tap
blocks.text: The text's example is the bursting of a sealed flask (he first reads *gid*, a vein, and is corrected to *nod*, a flask; either works). Or a spring in the ground, since *Arich* is said to have veins: plug it up and the pressure builds, and when it breaks through it pushes out extra. Or put your finger over the water tap and it comes out like a spritz. The blocking makes it stronger: having to go through the bone makes it a bigger thing than the original.

phrases.he: כמו החכמה כשגובר עליו כח בשכל ביותר, נופל ממנו נובלות,
phrases.en: When there's a very strong power in the *chachma*, that's when the *novlos* go down.

phrases.he: ששרש הנובלות יותר גבוה מגוף אור השכל
phrases.en: The *shoresh* of the *novlos* is higher than the actual body of the *or hasechel*.

phrases.he: ולכך אמר דנובלות חכמה של מעלה תורה,
phrases.en: It says that the Torah is just *novlos*.

phrases.he: לשבח דוקא, כמו שכתוב במקום אחר

blocks.text: When there is **a very strong power in the *chachma***, *novlos* (what falls off) fall from it, and **the *shoresh* of the *novlos* is higher than the actual body of the *or hasechel*** (the light of the intellect). So the Torah is called the *novlos* of the wisdom above, *davka* as praise. *Novlos* are like the leaves that fall off a tree, rotten leaves: the Torah, it says, is just the stuff that fell off.

blocks.title: The overflowing cup
blocks.text: It is like overfilling your cup: what spills over shows that the cup is overfull, *kosi revaya* (my cup overflows).

blocks.title: The morning after the farbrengen
blocks.text: A good *mashal* is a *farbrengen* (a Chassidic gathering). Come when it's over and see a few bottles of soda and some leftovers on the table, and you figure you didn't miss much. But if there's spaghetti on the walls, throw-up on the floor and people on the floor, you say, "Wow, I really missed it." On the floor, it was some party; on the walls, you really know. *Davka* (precisely) what fell off, the leftovers and the rotten stuff, shows what a great party it was.

sensitivity.reason: Vomit and people lying on the floor as the sign of a great farbrengen.
sensitivity.publishable: A good *mashal* is a *farbrengen* (a Chassidic gathering). Come when it's over and see a few bottles of soda and some leftovers on the table, and you figure you didn't miss much. But if there's spaghetti on the walls and food all over the floor, you say, "Wow, I really missed it." On the floor, it was some party; on the walls, you really know. *Davka* (precisely) what fell off, the leftovers and the rotten stuff, shows what a great party it was.

blocks.text: So the *mazalos* reach all the way up to the *gulgalta*. The *chachma* can come not only from the *chachma stima'a* of *Arich*, where there are already lines to the right and left, but *mamash* from the *gulgalta* itself, and from even higher. What spills over shows not only the *etzem haratzon* (the essence of the will) but the great *taanug* (delight). The *chesed* of *Atik* (the Ancient One) is enclothed in the *gulgalta*, and the *chesed* of *Atik* spreads out from the essence of the delight; so the *mazalos* can reach higher than *Arich*, higher than the *gulgalta*. That is why some places say the inner *Abba* is the inner *Atik*.
And where you see *bochurim* (yeshiva students) passed out under the table, it went all the way up to *Radla* (the unknowable head).

sensitivity.reason: Drunk yeshiva students passed out under the table as the sign of the highest level.
sensitivity.publishable: It can go all the way up to *Radla* (the unknowable head).

blocks.text: This level is not normal intellect: a new light is coming into the intellect. It is not really *chachma*, not even from the *chachma stima'a*, not even from the *koach hamaskil* alone. There is an overpowering of the *koach hamaskil*, and that is why there is the excess, the *novlos*. The *novlos* are the new ideas that come into *chachma* and *bina*.

blocks.title: Inventors and the airplane
blocks.text: This is not a very common thing. Even what inventors get is really not this level: as chapters 1 and 2 show, most of it is not a new light in *chachma* but *chachma* of *bina*. Even the airplane was not a whole new invention. It was a very big *chachma* of *bina*, a whole new mode of transportation, but still a mode of transportation; the Wright brothers were already into transportation, and they used mechanics and machinery. Every invention, however fantastic, is physical, something to do with where you are.

There is nothing new under the sun: from the caveman to us, it is only putting things together in a new way. This is a real *chiddush* (new thing), *mamash*, from above the sun, the kind that comes only from *hisbonenus* (contemplation) like the class is doing now.

Most inventions, inventive things like algebra, are sort of like this and not really; they have an element of coming from the *mazalos*. But the real *mazalos* reach higher than *Arich* altogether, all the way up to *Atik*. And *Atik* is not really part of the world; even the *gulgalta*, though it is already the root, is just a root, with no divisions there yet.
So this is not a common level. It is the level of a real human being, and as it says in many places, if there's no *hisbonenus*, he's not a human being.

sections.title: Everything depends on mazal: the thirteen attributes and the Sefer Torah in the sanctuary
sections.summary: The thirteen attributes of mercy come from the same leftovers of the hidden brain, so nursing from the *mazal* is above the hidden wisdom itself. That is why every real union of *chachma* and *bina*, every birth of a new idea, depends on the *mazal*.

phrases.he: וכך הוא טעם מעלות ענין שרש י''ג מדות הרחמים שנקרא בשם י''ג תיקוני דיקנא
phrases.en: All the *yud-gimmel middos harachamim*, *tikunei dikna*,

phrases.he: כו', שיוצאים ממותרי מוחא סתימאה
phrases.en: comes from the *mocha stima'a*, which goes through the *gulgalta*.

phrases.he: כו' וכמו שכתוב ויעבור יהו״ה על פניו
phrases.en: that He went past His *pnimiyus*

phrases.he: ויקרא יהו״ה יהו״ה שהוא מלמעלה ממוחא סתימאה שנקרא טעם וחכמה כמוסה לרצון הנעלם, ונקרא גם כן שכל הנעלם מכל רעיון או פלאות חכמה
ולפי זה כשאמר דאור אבא יונק ממזל כו', הרי זה למעלה מחכמה סתימאה עצמה

blocks.text: So the root of the thirteen attributes of mercy, called the thirteen *tikunei dikna* (adornments of the beard), is so high: they come from the leftovers of the *mocha stima'a*, which goes through the *gulgalta*. As it says, "*Havaya* (the four-letter Name) passed before his face": **He went past His *pnimiyus***, and called out *Havaya*, *Havaya*. If it is not *Havaya Havaya*, it is not this kind of intellect at all. It is *Havaya Havaya*, *Kel rachum v'chanun* (G-d, merciful and gracious), all the thirteen attributes: it has to be something of *Elokus* (G-dliness), of the inner G-dliness.

This is above the *mocha stima'a*, which is called the hidden reason of the hidden will, the intellect hidden from every thought. So when it says *Abba* nurses from the *mazal*, that is above the *chachma stima'a* itself: it comes through the *koach hamaskil*, but from higher than the *koach hamaskil*.

phrases.he: ולזה אמר הכל תלוי במזל,
phrases.en: Everything depends on *mazal*.

phrases.he: אפילו ספר תורה בהיכל, שהוא בחינת יחוד אבא ואמא למטה
נקודה דחכמה בהיכלא דבינה, מאין ליש כנזכר לעיל
שזהו ספר וספור
phrases.en: The *chachma* is called a *sefer*, and *bina* is called a *sippur*.

phrases.he: שנקרא ספר תורה בהיכל כידוע

blocks.text: So it says: **Everything depends on *mazal***, even a *Sefer Torah* in the sanctuary. The sanctuary is *chachma* and *bina*, the union of *Abba* and *Ima*, and all the unions depend on it. The real union has to have this happen; otherwise, though they are together, it is not a union that gives birth to a new thing.

blocks.title: The book, the narrative and the writer
blocks.text: The point of *chachma* in the sanctuary of *bina* is *sefer* and *sippur*. *Chachma* is the *sefer*, the whole book, like the title *The Lord of the Rings*: the whole idea. *Bina* is the *sippur*, the details, the narrative. There are really three, *sefer*, *sippur* and *sofer*, the writer: the book and the narrative come from the writer, who is much higher than both put together.

sections.title: The arms of Arich: the dark mountains, a will that blinds
sections.summary: The second level, *Abba* and *Ima* enclothing the arms of *Arich*, is the *middos* of the will, the dark mountains higher than the sun. Intellect driven by love or hate from there is bigger, and it is a bribe: unless the mind is very strong, the will overpowers it.

phrases.he: וזהו למעלה הרבה
phrases.en: this level is much, much higher

phrases.he: ממה שכתוב שאבא ואימא מלבישין לזרועות דאריך אנפין
ומכל שכן מבחינת נה''י דאריך אנפין שמלובשין באבא ואמא כו'

blocks.text: Now he comes to the second level. Nursing from the *mazal* is much, much higher than *Abba* and *Ima* enclothing the arms of *Arich*, and all the more than *Nehi* of *Arich*. The arms are much higher than *Nehi*, but those two are still in some proportion to each other: the inside and the outside of the *middos* (emotional attributes). The first is totally beyond comparison.

phrases.he: להיות ידוע שבחינת ז׳ תחתונים דאריך אנפין היינו רק בחינת המדות חג''ת כו'
שנקרא יד הגדולה ויד החזקה כו',
ונקרא גם כן בזהר בשם טורי חשוכא
phrases.en: This is called the Mountains of Darkness.

phrases.he: (כידוע במאמר דהאי איילתא אזלת לטורא חשוכא
phrases.en: this gazelle, *Malchus*, goes up to the dark mountains

phrases.he: ומשם ארחת מזונא
phrases.en: That's where she gets her food.

phrases.he: שזהו בחינת עליית המלכות בחג"ת דאריך אנפין כו'
וכמו שכתוב ותרם התיבה כו'
בחדש הז' שהוא ראש השנה שעולה המלכות בהרי אררט
טורי קרדניתא כו')
phrases.en: the dark mountains

phrases.he: כמו הרים הגבוהים שאין אור השמש מאיר עליהם כו'
phrases.en: Like high mountains: they're so high, they're higher than the sun.

blocks.text: The seven lower *sefiros* of *Arich* are only the *middos*, *Chagas* (*chesed*, *gevura*, *tiferes*), called the great hand and the strong hand, and in the *Zohar*, *turei chashocha*: **the Mountains of Darkness**. (He thought they had learned it before.) The first level is higher even than the dark mountains; the second level is the dark mountains, the inner *middos*, *chesed* and *gevura* of *Arich*.

As the *maamar* (discourse) says, **this gazelle, *Malchus*, goes up to the dark mountains**. **That's where she gets her food**: *Malchus* (kingship) rises into *Chagas* of *Arich* on *Rosh Hashana*. So the ark rested in the seventh month, *Rosh Hashana*, on the mountains of Ararat, the dark mountains. "Here it sounds really like something out of *Lord of the Rings*."
Why dark? **Like high mountains: they're so high, they're higher than the sun**, and the light of the sun does not shine on them.

phrases.he: והיינו בחינת המדות שברצון, שלמעלה מן השכל וטעם גלוי
phrases.en: They're higher than the *chachma* altogether.

phrases.he: מה שאין כן המדות שמצד שכל וטעם נקרא טורי דנהורא,
דחכמה נקרא אור כו'
phrases.en: The *sechel* lights up on them.

blocks.text: These are the *middos* of the will, above revealed intellect and reason: **They're higher than the *chachma* altogether**. The *middos* that come from the intellect are *turei d'nehora*, the mountains of light.

It ties in with chapter one: when *Moshiach* comes it will be like the days of the flood, when all the mountains were covered, not only the mountains of light but even *turei chashocha*. Why? Because it will come from the level of the *mazalos*, which are also called the veins. The windows of heaven are the tubes, and the veins of the earth are the tubes of the *mazalos*, through which it comes into the revealed *chachma* from the hidden *chachma*.

Those will open, and it will come not as a little flow but as a big flow, from that level, and cover all the mountains. So that level is not normal wisdom at all: it is the wisdom of the time of *Moshiach*, when there will be nothing but *daas Havaya* (knowing G-d). It is *davka* *Chassidus*, this type of *Chassidus* they are learning here.

blocks.question: Don't the dark mountains sound like evil?
blocks.text: They do. The dark mountains are the world of *Tohu* (chaos), the *middos* of the will. If they do not go through the intellect and get lit up by it, they are evil; that is what evil is: a man lets the *middos* of his will take over, and his intellect can do nothing about it. Someone objects that the curses in the Torah are really good, and that this is the *tov me'od*, the "very good". It is, when it gets lit up from an even higher level. But as things are now, if the dark mountains just take over, that is the whole matter of *Tohu*. The mountains of light are the ones the intellect lights up.
blocks.outOfPlace: The next tape opens with this, finishing lines 40-42 before it reads line 43.

phrases.he: אבל המדות שברצון נקרא טורי חשוכא, מדות שבהעלם הרצון
ושרשם מבחינת חכמה סתימאה הנזכר לעיל, שהוא הנקרא תעלומות חכמה ענין טעם כמוס לרצון שנחלק ממנו ב' קוין חסד וגבורה שברצון כו'
ולזה אמר דאבא ואמא מלבישין לזרועות חסד וגבורה דאריך אנפין
כמו שאנו רואים שמחמת מדת החסד ואהבה רבה שברצון, נמצא שרש לשכל וטעם לזכות ולחסד
כמו השוחד יעור כו'
phrases.en: It's *me'aver*, it blinds him.

phrases.he: שמחמת השוחד שיש לו אהבה ברצון ממציא טענה ומטעה כח שכלו מחוב לזכות

blocks.text: The *middos* in the will, *turei chashocha*, are rooted in the *chachma stima'a*, the *taalumos chachma* (hidden depths of wisdom), where the two lines of *chesed* and *gevura* in the will divide. Love in the will finds a reason to acquit, as a *shochad* (bribe) blinds. So this second level, higher than the normal one, can be a bad thing: **it blinds him**, when someone is really, really into something.
Like people who are fanatical about whatever: the whales, the crazy communists, the crazy terrorists, who came up with a real smart thing.

sensitivity.reason: Calls communists and terrorists crazy and lumps whale activists in with them.
sensitivity.publishable: Like people who are fanatical about whatever, who come up with a real smart thing.

blocks.text: There is a good side and a problem. The good side: intellect that comes from the inner *middos*, *chesed* and *gevura* of *Arich*, is bigger. Someone who is really into geology, or any science, comes up with big inventions. Someone totally into a thing, totally in love with it or totally hating it, is at the actual *chesed* and *gevura*.

blocks.title: Hannibal and the Maccabees
blocks.text: The great conquerors, a Hannibal, came up with fantastic strategies of war. The Maccabees, pushed to the wall, were at the essence of the *middos* of their will, the great love and the great hate.

The problem: it can totally blind you, as with the terrorists. The scientists come up with big ideas, but they have a blind spot: they want it so much to be like that, they can't let go of things like evolution. It can be very dark, the intellect not shining on it, though it brings much bigger ideas than *Nehi*.

sensitivity.reason: Says scientists are blinded by wanting their theories, evolution among them, and sets them beside terrorists.
sensitivity.publishable: The problem: it can totally blind you. Some thinkers come up with big ideas, but they have a blind spot: they want it so much to be like that, they can't let go of their theories. It can be very dark, the intellect not shining on it, though it brings much bigger ideas than *Nehi*.

phrases.he: וכמו ר׳ ישמעאל שלקח כלכלה דפירי,
phrases.en: He took a little thing of fruit from somebody, from his neighbor tenant farmer.

phrases.he: אמר אי בעי טעין הכי כו'
phrases.en: He should have said like this.

blocks.title: Rabbi Yishmael's basket of fruit
blocks.text: He is not sure whether it was Rabbi Yossi (the text says Rabbi Yishmael) and remembers the story only roughly. The rabbi took a little basket of fruit from his tenant farmer. He disqualified himself from the case, but he was there at the trial, and he caught himself thinking: oi, the farmer should have argued like this. Why? Because there was a *shochad*, and only from a little piece of fruit. The inner *middos* of *Arich* are a total *shochad*: on one side they can bring up fantastic ideas, on the other they can really blind a person.

phrases.he: נמצא המדות חסד וגבורה מלובשים בפנימית דאבא ואמא,
ובחינת אבא ואמא מלבישים אותן מבחוץ

blocks.text: So *chesed* and *gevura* are inside *Abba* and *Ima*, and *Abba* and *Ima* enclothe them from outside. The problem is that it goes according to what he wants. Unless a person has a very, very strong intellect, the will overpowers the intellect; by what the text says, it is almost for sure. *Abba* is just a garment for the will, almost not a thing by itself. That is why it says *malbishin*, enclothe. The other level is a descent of light; here the will is right inside it.
You notice it in politics: people who are really into things come up with brilliant debates and brilliant books, ideas that look fantastically convincing.

blocks.question: If the *middos* of the will can do that, why is there no warning about the higher level, the *gulgalta*, the essence of the will?
blocks.text: That is the inner intellect, the *chachma stima'a* and higher, higher than the will itself; from the thirteen attributes of mercy they can even change the will. It is a connection to *Elokus* and can only be good. In the world of *Tohu* the fanatical will can be cut off from *Elokus*, though connected it can be *tov me'od*, very good; the level above cannot be cut off, because it is *Elokus*.

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב אני בינה לי גבורה דאריך אנפין כו',
phrases.en: Inside of me is *gevura* of *Arich Anpin*.

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב בעץ חיים ודי למבין

blocks.text: As it says, "I am *bina*, *gevura* is mine": **Inside of me is *gevura* of *Arich Anpin***, as the *Etz Chaim* explains. This is the second level.

sections.title: Netzach and hod: the normal mind, and still unlimited in Arich
sections.summary: The third level, receiving from *netzach* and *hod* of *Arich*, is the normal intellect: the will sends through only as much as the mind can weigh and process. Yet even this is unlimited, because it is still *Arich*.

phrases.he: ובירידת המדרגה עוד, אין מוחין דחכמה ובינה דאצילות מקבלים רק מבחינת נצח והוד דאריך אנפין
שהוא הבאת השפע דחסד וגבורה למטה
כמו נצח והוד
שנקרא מאזני צדק בכמה מקומות,
phrases.en: In any place where it says *netzach* and *hod*, it's called *moznei tzedek*.

phrases.he: גם למטה במדות שמצד אור השכל

blocks.text: Lower still, the minds of *Atzilus* (the world of emanation) receive only from *netzach* and *hod* of *Arich*. It does not say enclothing here; it says receiving. They receive some light and are still themselves, able to process it. This is the normal intellectual process.

The flow of *chesed* and *gevura* comes down not as the actual *chesed* and *gevura* with no *tzimtzum* (contraction), but through *netzach* and *hod*, everywhere called *moznei tzedek*, scales of justice: a weight of how much to give. *Netzach* gives out (*nitzuach* is going into the other man's property); *hod* holds back, giving only *hoda'a*, so that he concedes without being told the actual thing.

From the will it goes through *netzach* and *hod*, and a little light comes into the intellect of what he wants to think about; according to that, he thinks. Normally the will does not overpower the intellect. He knows what he wants, and how much he wants to get into it, a lot or a little. He is not a total fanatic who can't think of anything else.

phrases.he: רק במדות שברצון שנקרא אריכות דאנפין, הן בלתי מוגבלים, כמו הרצון עצמו שהוא בלתי מוגבל
על כן גם בחינת נצח והוד הן בבחינת בלתי מוגבל
וכידוע דפירוש זכר רב טובך, הוא בחינת יסוד דאריך אנפין
וכן ובטובך הגדול וכהאי גוונא, וכן אם יגאלך טוב, ורב טוב לבית ישראל וכהאי גוונא

blocks.title: A fruit stand and a chain of supermarkets
blocks.text: Only the *middos* of the will, *Arich*, are unlimited like the will itself, so even its *netzach* and *hod* are. Even a little will reaching the intellect does not want a little fruit stand; it wants a worldwide chain of supermarkets. Through *netzach* and *hod* the intellect can think, "But I've got to start with a fruit stand." Will and intellect are two different things, yet without the ambition he would not think about it at all, in business or in anything else.

You would say *netzach* and *hod* are already a limiting of *chesed* and *gevura*. Compared with *chesed* and *gevura* of *Arich* they are, but they are still unlimited: it is still *Arich*. So "the remembrance of Your great goodness" is *yesod* of *Arich*: only a remembrance, but of Your great goodness. So too "in Your great goodness": good is the *tzaddik*, and the *tzaddik* is *yesod*.

sections.title: Yesod of Zeir Anpin, the smallest, and the three levels in review
sections.summary: After *bina* has weighed the matter, *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin* is the smallest: the house a man can afford, where in *Arich* even the urge is infinite. The class ends by laying out the three levels of intellect again: the *mazalos*, the arms, and *Nehi* of *Arich*.

phrases.he: מה שאין כן בחינת יסוד זעיר אנפין, שהוא בחינת מדות שנולדים מבינה
הוא בבחינת הקטנות ביותר
phrases.en: Then it comes very little already.

blocks.text: *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin* (the small countenance), *middos* born of *bina*, is the smallest: after *chachma* and *bina*, when he thinks it over and analyzes the situation, **it comes very little already**. A fruit stand: that's the most he can put together. The ambition for a house, even in *Nehi* of *Arich*, is a fantastically infinite house, a palace.
In general, the difference between *Chagas* and *Nehi* is that in the essence of the *middos* he cannot yet go outside the *middah*.

blocks.title: Too angry to say a word
blocks.text: When somebody is really angry he *mamash* can't do anything: shaking with anger, he can't talk or shout at the guy, he can't even call him a *putz*. He has to calm down a little just to shoot the guy. In the essence of the anger, *Chagas*, he is inside the *middah* itself. *Nehi* is already its *hispaalus* (stirring), what he wants to come out of it: now he can punch the guy in the nose.

sensitivity.publishable: When somebody is really angry he *mamash* can't do anything: shaking with anger, he can't talk or shout at the guy. He has to calm down a little just to shoot the guy. In the essence of the anger, *Chagas*, he is inside the *middah* itself. *Nehi* is already its *hispaalus* (stirring), what he wants to come out of it: now he can punch the guy in the nose.

blocks.text: But in *Arich* even that is infinite. *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin*, after *bina*, is already the very smallest: the house he can afford, the car he can afford.

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר בענין צדיק כתמר, שזהו בחינת יסוד זעיר אנפין
כארז בלבנון ישגה, בבחינת אין סוף, שהוא ביסוד עתיק יומין ואריך אנפין
וכן מה שכתוב בשלמה, וידבר מן הארז
אשר בלבנון
phrases.en: in *Arich*

phrases.he: עד האזוב,
phrases.en: till the weed

phrases.he: בחינת קטנות יסוד זעיר אנפין במלכות, שנקרא קיר כו'

blocks.text: As explained elsewhere, "the *tzaddik* will flourish like a palm" is *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin*; "like a cedar in Lebanon he will grow tall" is infinite, in *yesod* of *Atik* and *Arich*. *Levanon* is from *lavan*, white, which means *Keser* (crown). So Shlomo spoke "from the cedar in Lebanon", **in *Arich***, "to the hyssop", **till the weed** in the wall: the smallness of *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin* in *Malchus*, which is called a wall.

phrases.he: (וכידוע בכוונות דאמן יהא שמיא רבא מברך דשמו גי' רצון ושמו הגדול בבחינת יסוד ומלכות דאריך
שיהיה מבורך באבא ואמא וזעיר אנפין ונוקבא כו'
לאגברא ימינא על שמאלא
phrases.en: to overpower the right and the left

phrases.he: וכמו ובטובך הגדול ישוב כו' ודי למבין)

blocks.text: So too the intentions of *Amen, yehei shmei rabba mevarach*: *shmei*, His Name, has the numerical value of *ratzon* (will), and His great Name is *yesod* and *Malchus* of *Arich*. Earlier it was said to be the *machshava kduma* (the primordial thought); here it is *yesod* of *Arich*, blessed into *Abba* and *Ima* and *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva* (the female): from *yesod* of *Arich* down into the minds and the *middos*, **to overpower the right and the left**.

blocks.question: Why is *Malchus* called a wall?
blocks.text: No one has a ready answer. *Malchus* is called all kinds of things, a stone, the earth. A wall is where it stops, and where the hyssop grows from. Another reason: a wall is built of stones, like the letters they will learn about later. There are all kinds of reasons, and the class leaves the Kabbalistic ones aside.

In short, there are three levels of intellect, from *Chabad*, *Chagas* and *Nehi* of *Arich*. The real level is the *mazalos*, from which the intellect of *hisbonenus* gets its things, and they reach higher than the *gulgalta*: the *mazalos* are the inner delight overpowering the will.

Then there are the arms of *Arich*, called enclothing: the will is dressed inside the intellect and drives it. With such a person you are not dealing with an intellect, you are dealing with a will, and you have to be careful and know it.

The next chapter explains the three kinds of minds that come from these three levels: from the *koach hamaskil* itself, and really from higher than it; from the inner *middos* of *Arich*, whose arms also receive from the *chachma stima'a*, so that it always comes from the *koach hamaskil*; or from the outer *middos* of *Arich*. That is the normal way: the will does not overpower the intellect, which receives light from there and processes it.

The highest type, from the *chachma stima'a*, is much, much higher than the others. Not only does it not overpower the intellect: it is a whole different intellect. This person is thinking with the *koach hamaskil* itself and higher, and the rest is just conduits. Here too you are not dealing with an intellect but with the inner intellect directly.

You see it in the great Jewish *chachamim* (sages) and *geonim* (geniuses): there is no comparison between them and the wise men of the *goyim* (the nations). Not big philosophers: theirs is a G-dly wisdom. They know things a person should not be able to know; their wisdom is not big but infinite. This level comes only when it is connected to *Havaya Havaya*, *Kel rachum v'chanun*: it is G-dliness.

sensitivity.reason: Says gentile wise men cannot reach this wisdom at all, in contrast to the Jewish sages.
sensitivity.publishable: You see it in the great Jewish *chachamim* (sages) and *geonim* (geniuses). Not big philosophers: theirs is a G-dly wisdom. They know things a person should not be able to know; their wisdom is not big but infinite. This level comes only when it is connected to *Havaya Havaya*, *Kel rachum v'chanun*: it is G-dliness.

reviewQuestions.question: What three answers does the text give for where *Abba* and *Ima* receive from *Arich*, and how far apart are they?
Why are the *mazalos* called hairs, and how does their breaking out as leftovers show that their root is higher than the hidden brain?
What does the morning after a *farbrengen* show about *novlos*, and why is the Torah called the *novlos* of the wisdom above?
Why can a mind fed from the arms of *Arich* see bigger and still be blinded, and why is there no such danger at the level of the *mazal*?
How do *netzach* and *hod* work as scales of justice in a normal mind, and why are they still unlimited in *Arich*?
How does a man too angry to speak show the difference between *Chagas* and *Nehi*?

notes.text: 038 w13-22: "Chapter 25 basically goes along with 1, 2, and 3." It is not clear whether he means chapters 1-3 or the three answers the chapter opens with; the block leaves it out.
Line 4: he reads "בחוורתא" (and "בחוורא") where the chapter has "בחסד וגבורה", but renders it "enclothed in chesed and gevura".
Line 25: he reads "הגיד" and a listener corrects it to "הנוד" (038 w1104-1133); both readings are in the block.

A term the transcript gives as "טוהר דקרדינותא" (038 w2409-2446, "like you remember with the ...") and "תורא דקרדינותא" (039 w716-737) could not be made out (bozina d'kardinusa? the turei kardunia of line 39?). The blocks leave it out rather than guess.

038 w2728-2769: "If it's something to do with a physical world, it's Havaya Havaya Kel rachum v'chanun, it's all yud-gimmel middos harachamim. It has to be something with Elokus": the point is unclear; the block keeps only that it is Havaya Havaya, the thirteen attributes, and of the inner G-dliness.

The story of the basket of fruit: he is unsure of the name ("I don't know if this is Rabbi Yossi I think") and of the details. It is the Gemara's story (Kesubos 105b) of Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yossi, whose sharecropper brought him a basket of fruit; he disqualified himself and, watching the case, caught himself thinking how the man could argue. The block keeps his telling.

The transcript has no speaker labels. In 039 w0-216 (the dark mountains and evil) and 039 w2518-2670 (why Malchus is called a wall) it is not clear which voice is the teacher's: who says "I have no idea" and "I'm not into Kabbalistic things". The blocks are written so as not to depend on it; askedBy is a guess.
039 w1112-1155 (people in politics come up with brilliant debates and books) is not flagged: it is about how a will drives the mind, not about a party or person.
The 039 opening (w0-216, on lines 40-42) is placed under lines 41-42 with outOfPlace, and his rendering of the end of line 42 ("the sechel lights up on them") is taken from it.
